models.name: Flarepib
models.appearance: Small, red-orange tadpole with amber eyes and a translucent belly that flickers like a candle flame. Its back features three nub-like heat vents that puff out steam when it hops.

models.name: Lumacroak
models.appearance: A bipedal frog with smooth, copper-colored skin and luminous linear markings across its limbs. Its throat sac is crystalline and pulses with light in time with its heartbeat.

models.name: Solamphibos
models.appearance: Elegant amphibian with golden-white skin, sun motifs across its arms and back, and gently glowing eyes. It stands tall like a sage, radiating warmth and light in soft pulses.

models.name: Verdreep
models.appearance: Otter-like hollowing wrapped in green-brown seaweed fur, with small leaf-like ears and curious blue eyes. Bubbles constantly trail from its paws.

models.name: Phantotter
models.appearance: Translucent green otter with faint spectral ripples flowing along its body. Its tail splits into ethereal strands resembling water plants waving in unseen tides.

models.name: Abyreedon
models.appearance: Majestic, kelp-cloaked otter with a ghostly pale chest and bright emerald flames drifting between its paws. Its eyes resemble glowing pools of deep water.

models.name: Rivanos
models.appearance: A small blue dinosaur hatchling with a domed skull and bright white snout. Tiny fins line the sides of its tail, aiding fast swimming.

models.name: Terrinoir
models.appearance: Grey-blue reptile with tough plating over its back and a sleek body. Its horns start to curve backward, decorated with algae-like streaks from deep-water battles.

models.name: Duskuragon
models.appearance: Massive dinosaur-like hollowing with pitch-black horns, deep cerulean scales, and a faint dark shimmer. Its skull glows faintly blue from inner energy, like light seen through deep water.

models.name: Pupawn
models.appearance: A small beige puppy with soft fur. Its eyes glimmer faintly, sometimes shifting hue in correspondence with unseen elemental forces.

models.name: Ignisrael
models.appearance: A tall wolf with a crimson-gold mane of living fire, obsidian horns, and dark ash streaks along its legs. Flames leak from deep cracks in its fur.

models.name: Torrentis
models.appearance: Streamlined blue wolf with a sleek fin mane. Its paws leave rippling water trails on the ground.

models.name: Verdama
models.appearance: A moss-green wolf with leaves sprouting from its back and tail. Small flowers illuminate its path at night.

models.name: Runaris
models.appearance: A silver-gray wolf with multicolored runic etchings flowing across its body like living lines of code.

models.name: Noctyros
models.appearance: A sleek black wolf with violet eyes and shadow-striped fur that seems to absorb light.

models.name: Solarune
models.appearance: Golden-white wolf wreathed in faint halo light. Its eyes burn like tiny suns.

models.name: Gravulor
models.appearance: Massive earth-toned wolf with thick armor plates and crystal claws.

models.name: Wraithound
models.appearance: A translucent wolf whose body flickers like fading smoke. Its howl echoes as overlapping whispers.

models.name: Tempestral
models.appearance: Feathered wolf with wispy wings of vapor and lightning eyes. Its paws barely touch the ground.

models.name: Cryovelis
models.appearance: Pale-blue fur shimmering with frost. Its breath releases snowflakes, and its eyes glow like frozen moons.

models.name: Voltalis
models.appearance: A wolf of bright yellow fur streaked with jagged black patterns. Its tail sparks constantly.

models.name: Venomaris
models.appearance: A dark violet wolf with green luminescent veins pulsing under translucent skin. Toxic fumes trail from its snarling jaws.

models.name: Ferronyx
models.appearance: A metallic wolf whose silver armor plates shift like interlocking gears. Its claws leave sparks with every step.

models.name: Eclipsera
models.appearance: Half its body shines with golden fur, the other half draped in shifting shadow. A thin halo and dark crescent orbit above its head.

models.name: Pipereef
models.appearance: A marble-sized sea slug with a fin-like crest and bead-black eyes. Its back has two reed-like siphons that whistle softly when it swims.

models.name: Reedmollusk
models.appearance: A sleek, palm-length mollusk with wing-shaped fins and two long siphons like reeds. Its shell fragments form a collar that rattles when it accelerates.

models.name: Nibbkit
models.appearance: A kitten-like hollowing with oversized paws and a stitched-looking fur pattern. Its tail ends in a little puff shaped like a pom-pom.

models.name: Purlarcen
models.appearance: A sleek cat with a mask-like face marking and a long ribbon tail that seems to fade at the tip. Its whiskers glitter like fine wire.

models.name: Twigglo
models.appearance: A tiny stick-sprite with a bud for a head and a leaf-cape. Its chest has a bead of resin that pulses softly at dusk.

models.name: Brambright
models.appearance: A bramble-bodied sprite with a crown of glowing buds. Its arms end in thorny fans that shimmer like stained glass.

models.name: Solbriar
models.appearance: A tall briar guardian with vine armor and a sunburst halo of petals. Golden resin runs in lines like veins across its limbs.

models.name: Mitelet
models.appearance: A pill-bug larva with a dirt-caked shell and two violet feelers. It rolls into a pebble-sized ball when threatened.

models.name: Caraphex
models.appearance: A plated burrower with hexagon segments and purple crystal studs. Its foreclaws are spade-shaped and constantly drip dark sap.

models.name: Cindlark
models.appearance: A small charcoal-gray bird with ember-red wing tips. Its chest has a faint glow like a banked coal, brightening when it sings.

models.name: Pyrocor
models.appearance: A hawk-like bird with broad wings that look dusted in ash. Its tail feathers burn in a controlled arc, leaving a brief ribbon of heat haze.

models.name: Noxling
models.appearance: A small shadow-hollowing with a candle-wick tail and pale dot eyes. Its body looks like folded cloth made of night.

models.name: Ferrimaw
models.appearance: A squat junkyard monster with riveted jaw armor and magnet-like horns. Its forearms end in clamp claws with worn serrations.

models.name: Niblet
models.appearance: A tiny, round rodent with oversized front teeth, soft beige fur, and twitchy pink ears. Its tail is short and fluffy like a cotton ball.

models.name: Gnawer
models.appearance: A stocky, aggressive-looking rodent with powerful jaws and dark brown fur. Scars mark its face from territorial battles, and its claws are thick and curved.

models.name: Puddlop
models.appearance: A translucent blue blob with two dark circular eyes floating inside. Small ripples constantly move across its gelatinous surface.

models.name: Sparkbug
models.appearance: A small beetle with a bright yellow carapace marked with black lightning bolt patterns. Its antennae crackle with tiny arcs of electricity.

models.name: Voltbeetle
models.appearance: A large rhinoceros beetle with a metallic blue-black shell and a glowing yellow horn. Electricity visibly arcs between its mandibles.

models.name: Peblit
models.appearance: A small, round stone hollowing with stubby legs and curious pebble eyes. Cracks in its surface reveal a faint orange glow from its molten core.

models.name: Boulrock
models.appearance: A boulder-shaped hollowing with thick rocky limbs and glowing orange veins running through its body. Its face is stern and weathered.

models.name: Terramight
models.appearance: A massive humanoid golem with a body of dark stone reinforced with metallic ore veins. Magma glows through cracks in its chest, and its eyes burn like furnaces.

models.name: Frostling
models.appearance: A small, wispy white spirit with icy blue eyes and frost crystals forming its translucent body. A sad expression is frozen on its face.

models.name: Venomite
models.appearance: A sickly green fly with compound eyes that ooze purple liquid. Its wings have a toxic sheen, and its body is covered in pustules.

models.name: Plaguewing
models.appearance: A large, menacing fly with tattered wings dripping with venom. Its segmented body pulses with sickly bioluminescence, and a cloud of miasma surrounds it.

models.name: Shroombud
models.appearance: A tiny mushroom hollowing with a spotted red and white cap. Two beady eyes peek out from under the cap, and small root-like feet allow it to waddle around.

models.name: Fungrowth
models.appearance: A medium-sized mushroom with a purple-spotted cap and multiple smaller mushrooms growing from its body. Glowing spores constantly drift from its gills.

models.name: Sporecrown
models.appearance: A regal mushroom hollowing with a golden crown-shaped cap adorned with bioluminescent spots. Its body is thick and trunk-like, with smaller symbiotic fungi growing in patterns like royal robes.

models.name: Whispling
models.appearance: A wispy, translucent hollowing that resembles a small cloud with two hollow eyes. Faint faces of the departed occasionally appear and fade within its misty form.

models.name: Phantgale
models.appearance: A massive, swirling vortex of spectral energy with a central eye like a hurricane. Ghostly arms reach out from the storm, and tortured faces swirl within the winds.

models.name: Tindertail
models.appearance: A small squirrel with russet fur and a magnificent tail that flickers with orange flames. Its cheeks are puffy with stored embers, and its eyes sparkle with mischief.

models.name: Shadowpup
models.appearance: A small, wolf-like hollowing made of living shadow. Only its glowing red eyes and white fangs are clearly visible. Wisps of darkness trail from its form.

models.name: Duskhound
models.appearance: A sleek, muscular wolf composed of solidified shadow. Dark smoke billows from its fur, and its eyes glow like dying embers. Sharp bone-like protrusions extend from its shoulders.

models.name: Nighterror
models.appearance: A massive, three-headed wolf beast wreathed in black flames. Each head has different glowing eyes—red, purple, and white. Its body seems to absorb light itself, and spectral chains drag behind it.

models.name: Glimmoth
models.appearance: A delicate moth with wings that shimmer like stained glass. Its body glows with soft golden light, and its feathery antennae detect the faintest photons.

models.name: Radianthra
models.appearance: A magnificent moth with enormous wings that display shifting aurora patterns. Its body radiates warm light like a miniature sun, and prismatic dust falls from its wings as it flies.

models.name: Coglin
models.appearance: A small, goblin-like hollowing made of mismatched gears, springs, and metal plates. Its eyes are old lightbulbs that flicker, and steam occasionally vents from its joints.

models.name: Mechagrin
models.appearance: A hulking mechanical humanoid with a furnace in its chest and smokestacks on its shoulders. Its face is a permanent metallic grin, and its arms can transform into hammers, drills, or claws.

models.name: Embercub
models.appearance: A chubby bear cub with orange-red fur that glows at the tips. Tiny flames flicker from its rounded ears, and its paw pads leave scorched footprints.

models.name: Flamebear
models.appearance: A muscular bear with deep crimson fur and a mane of flames around its neck. Its claws glow white-hot, and smoke rises from its nostrils with each breath.

models.name: Infernursus
models.appearance: A colossal bear wreathed in flames and magma. Its fur is made of cooling volcanic rock with rivers of lava flowing through cracks. Its eyes burn like twin suns, and each step causes minor tremors.

models.name: Glacimite
models.appearance: A crystalline hollowing with a body of blue ice interlaced with silvery metal veins. Sharp icicles protrude from its back like spines, and frost constantly emanates from its core.

models.name: Lumikid
models.appearance: A small, cherubic hollowing with pale golden skin that radiates soft light. Its eyes are large and kind, and small wings of pure light flutter behind it. A halo-like glow crowns its head.

models.name: Volteel
models.appearance: A long, serpentine eel with deep blue scales and yellow lightning-bolt patterns. Electricity arcs between its fins, and its eyes glow with an electric blue light.

models.name: Ironhide
models.appearance: A massive armadillo-like hollowing covered in overlapping plates of dark gray metal. Its claws are reinforced for digging, and its eyes peek out from narrow slits in its armored face.

models.name: Snochi
models.appearance: A tiny, white rabbit-like Pokémon with fur that sparkles like fresh powder and large, blue-tipped ears.

models.name: Snoven
models.appearance: A medium-sized hare with thick, insulating ruffs of fur around its neck and paws that have developed small, sharp ice-claws.

models.name: Glacimal
models.appearance: A large, spectral white hare that appears to be made of swirling snow-mist. Its eyes glow with a chilling blue light.

models.name: Harefrost
models.appearance: A muscular, armored hare. Its ears have become heavy metallic blades and its fur has a polished, silvery sheen.

models.name: Sparkle
models.appearance: A floating yellow mote of light with tiny, crackling electricity arms and a joyful face.

models.name: Voltwing
models.appearance: A sleek, bird-like hollowing made of yellow lightning with translucent, cloud-like wings.

models.name: Stormlord
models.appearance: A massive, four-winged thunderbird with eyes that flash like lightning and a tail of dark storm clouds.

models.name: Currenshell
models.appearance: A tortoise-like Pokémon with a shell made of copper coils and a head that looks like a lightbulb.

models.name: Ohm-Titan
models.appearance: A colossal, bipedal machine-like hollowing with massive Tesla coils on its back and a body of reinforced steel.

models.name: Glub
models.appearance: A round, blue fish with big, vacant eyes and a perpetually open mouth.

models.name: Glub-Glub
models.appearance: A larger, slightly grumpier fish with more defined fins and a sturdy jaw.

models.name: Glub-Abyss
models.appearance: A terrifying, deep-sea angler fish with pitch-black scales and a glowing red lure.

models.name: Glub-Arctic
models.appearance: A majestic, crystalline fish with fins that look like jagged icicles and scales that shimmer like frost.

models.name: Icipillar
models.appearance: A fuzzy, light-blue caterpillar with purple poisonous spikes along its back.

models.name: Frostsalis
models.appearance: A hard, translucent cocoon made of ice and purple venom. It is nearly impossible to break.

models.name: Moth-Frost
models.appearance: A delicate moth with enormous, snowflake-patterned wings and long, feathery antennae.

models.name: Venom-Glaze
models.appearance: A sleek, predatory insect with sharp, needle-like wings and glowing purple veins.

models.name: Petal
models.appearance: A small green seedling with a single, large pink petal on its head like a hat.

models.name: Bloom-Bud
models.appearance: A slender plant with several tightly closed flower buds around its neck.

models.name: Sun-Bather
models.appearance: A tall, sun-flower like hollowing with glowing golden petals and a body of vibrant green vines.

models.name: Moon-Dancer
models.appearance: A dark purple lily-like Pokémon with petals that glow with a faint, silvery lunar light.

models.name: Solarius
models.appearance: A majestic phoenix-like hollowing with feathers of pure golden light and flames. A corona of solar fire surrounds its head like a crown, and its tail trails ribbons of plasma. Its eyes hold the intensity of a star.

models.name: Lumidrake
models.appearance: Sleek and radiant dragon with opalescent scales that refract light like stained glass. Its wings shimmer in gold and silver as if woven from sunlight.

models.name: Umbradrake
models.appearance: A serpentine dragon cloaked in rippling shadow. Its scales look like broken shards of glass reflecting dim stars, and its red eyes cut through darkness.

models.name: Eclipserion
models.appearance: A translucent dragon with a ring-like mane resembling an eclipse corona. Its body seems half-solid, phasing between physical and spectral states.
